tools.name: get_disclaimer
tools.description: Return CryptoDecentral’s canonical educational fence and legal URLs. Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: get_site_posture
tools.description: Return site posture: what CryptoDecentral is and is not (no custody, swaps, advice). Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: list_pillars
tools.description: List educational pillars (privacy, wallets, deai, nostr, …) with summaries. Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: get_pillar
tools.description: Get one pillar by id (slug). Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List curated directory listings (schema 1.2.0). Optional filters: q, category, tag. Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: search_directory
tools.description: Search directory listings by query/category/tag (unranked educational match). Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get a single directory listing by id. Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search notes, guides, and/or pillars by title/summary. type optional: notes|guides|pillars|all. Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List educational guides (slug, title, description, url). Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Get one guide by slug: title, description, publishedAt, readingTime, url, and plain-text body. Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List educational notes (slug, title, description, tags, url). Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Get one note by slug: title, description, publishedAt, tags, url, audio url, sources, and plain-text body. Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: get_metrics_snapshot
tools.description: Educational public network metrics snapshot (mempool fees in sat/vB, difficulty, Tor, Nostr sample) with a methodology block naming each public source and its refresh. Not our own node. No asset prices or trading signals. Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: get_dex_pulse
tools.description: Educational DefiLlama DEX pulse: the five largest Dexs-category protocols by reported TVL and volume (size order, not a ranking), plus overview 24h volume and a methodology block. Not prices, not a trade ranking, not a swap. Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: get_llms_map
tools.description: Return the site’s llms.txt map (short) or llms-full.txt (full). Education only, not financial advice.

tools.name: glossary_lookup
tools.description: Look up CryptoDecentral glossary terms: plain-English definitions (40 words max) with related notes, see-also terms and primary sources. slug = exact match; q = match term, then alias, then definition text; neither = list terms (optionally by pillar). No match returns count 0. Education only, not fi
